evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture.
